Everyday Life in San Andreas

@rekergames64 reinterprets the San Andreas universe by bringing the iconic game character CJ into today’s everyday life.

Smartphones, social media and internet culture collide with the game’s distinctive visual world.

Blending the gaming aesthetics of the 2000s with today’s habits, Everyday Life in San Andreas mixes nostalgia with humor and invites us to look at a familiar universe from a different perspective.

Because clearly, life in San Andreas is about much more than missions and chaos. 👾
